querystring.select: SELECT RM.DESCR AS MrCustModelCode , RP.PROFESSION_NAME AS ProfessionName, CPJD.PROFESSIONAL_NO AS ProfessionalNo ,CPJD.JOB_TITLE_NAME AS JobTitleName, RIT.INDUSTRY_TYPE_NAME AS IndustryTypeName, CPJD.EMPLOYMENT_ESTABLISHMENT_DT AS EmploymentEstablishmentDt
querystring.from: FROM dbo.CUST CU WITH(NOLOCK) LEFT JOIN dbo.CUST_PERSONAL_JOB_DATA CPJD WITH(NOLOCK) ON CPJD.CUST_ID = CU.CUST_ID LEFT JOIN dbo.REF_INDUSTRY_TYPE RIT WITH(NOLOCK) ON RIT.REF_INDUSTRY_TYPE_ID = CPJD.REF_INDUSTRY_TYPE_ID LEFT JOIN dbo.REF_PROFESSION RP WITH(NOLOCK) ON RP.REF_PROFESSION_ID = CPJD.REF_PROFESSION_ID LEFT JOIN dbo.REF_MASTER AS RM WITH(NOLOCK) ON CU.MR_CUST_MODEL_CODE = RM.MASTER_CODE AND 'CUST_MODEL' = RM.REF_MASTER_TYPE_CODE
